projects.name: ChooseTheFuture
projects.summary: The project behind this site: choose community software projects to support, and lend your coding agent to maintainer-approved work.
projects.example: A maintainer labels a small issue, a volunteer's agent does the work, and a reviewed pull request arrives with ChooseTheFuture accountable for it.

projects.name: Ratings Fixer for Jellyfin
projects.summary: A Jellyfin plugin that re-rates a media library to modern parental-rating standards, using TMDb certifications, Common Sense Media ratings via MDBList, and your own rules.
projects.example: A parent can make sure children's profiles only show age-appropriate films, even when a title's original rating is missing or out of date. It only ever raises ratings, and every change can be undone.

projects.name: Jellyfin Watch Sync
projects.summary: Syncs watch history and collections between Jellyfin and YAMTrack or a CSV file, in either direction, matching titles by their TMDB ID.
projects.example: Move to a new Jellyfin server, or keep a tracker in step with what you've watched, without losing your history.

related.label: Web UI (xyOps container)
related.note: A pre-configured web interface in one container, with no command line needed.
